Human control

An override is
a documented proposal.

A reviewer can reject or revise an assumption with a reason and evidence. They cannot convert missing proof into verified evidence, issue a government determination, or enable external execution.

Jurisdiction & content

Coverage is a
lane-specific question.

The CSL is not the whole import-compliance universe. Forced-labor restrictions, admissibility, other agency requirements, additional tariffs, AD/CVD, and ownership diligence may require separate investigation.

Privacy in this preview

Explore without
sending private records.

The demo uses synthetic session-local state. Inquiry forms only preview and download a request; they do not send or store your details. Optional interaction diagnostics stay in this browser session.
